config.rationale: Reducing label smoothing (0.1→0.05) and weight decay (0.01→0.005) while lowering LR (5e-4→3e-4) will improve validation accuracy by ~0.1-0.3% over t0004's 99.62%. Rationale: (1) Label smoothing of 0.1 forces the model to assign ~1.1% probability to every class, which is excessive for 9 classes where most are visually distinct at 28x28; reducing to 0.05 allows sharper decision boundaries on the clearly separable classes (epithelium, lymphocytes, adipose) while class_weighting still protects the minority classes. (2) Weight decay of 0.01 with AdamW is relatively strong for a 90k-sample dataset; 0.005 reduces the regularization pressure, allowing the model to fit the subtle texture differences that distinguish confusable pairs (smooth muscle vs stroma, background vs debris). (3) The lower LR (3e-4) combined with cosine decay over 50 epochs provides a longer fine-tuning phase where the model can settle into a sharper minimum, as evidenced by t0004's continued improvement from epoch 15→29.
